mapper.select: SELECT r.*, u.username as user_name FROM review r LEFT JOIN user u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE r.id = #{id}
SELECT r.*, u.username as user_name FROM review r LEFT JOIN user u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE r.product_id = #{productId} AND r.status = 1 ORDER BY r.create_time DESC
SELECT r.*, u.username as user_name FROM review r LEFT JOIN user u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE r.order_id = #{orderId}

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review (order_id, product_id, user_id, rating, content, images, create_time) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{productId}, #{userId}, #{rating}, #{content}, #{images}, #{createTime})
